messages:
emily_support: FYI customer reported a 401 invalid_api_key right after rotating their key. They say they copied it from our dashboard and pasted into their app, then saw immediate failures. suspecting encoding issue.

mike_sre: Can you paste the curl they used and any request_id from our logs? also which client/platform?

emily_support: here's what they ran (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/complete \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_AbC+DeF/ghi+jkLm==' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
They say server responded with 401 invalid_api_key. Request id from their side: req_12ab34cd (they reported). SDK: custom node http client, not our SDK.

danielle_engineer: quick check of server logs for req_12ab34cd shows received header: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_AbC&DeF/ghi+jkLm==` — the `+` turned into `&` (HTML entity). That will definitely break validation (signature mismatch/char diff).

emily_support: oh interesting — customer copied from an internal ticket that goes through our webmail and might HTML-escape `+`. they pasted into their config and didn't notice.

mike_sre: steps to repro for support: ask customer to echo the header their app sends (e.g., log raw header or show devtools/network). also ask them to try `printf '%s' "<pasted key>" | hexdump -C` to see bytes.

emily_support: asked them to run `node -e "console.log(Buffer.from(process.env.API_KEY || '').toString('hex'))"` and send last 8 hex chars; they sent `4e6b2f3d` which matches key ending `==` — but middle differs from expected.

danielle_engineer: remediation options: 1) tell customer to re-copy key using our dashboard copy button (which copies raw), or paste into plain-text editor first to ensure no HTML entities; 2) short-term server-side: we can't permissively decode `&` because that could mask real keys — security risk. we should log an explanatory error message to support flows.

alex_dev: also created a quick check in web UI backlog: detect `+` in key and show a tooltip warning if user copies via mouse from any HTML-rendered view. filing issue RDW-4192.

support-bot: Incident note: related support ticket #SUP-2026 linked to thread. 

emily_support: customer confirms decoding the `&` to `+` locally fixed the issue. asked them to rotate key and use copy-button as best practice. they'll mark resolved if no further issues. :thumbsup:

mike_sre: marking for follow-up: add a short KB article explaining HTML entity issues (copy from emails/roundtrip through rich text). i'll sync with docs.

danielle_engineer: logging TODO: include a diagnostic hint in 401 responses (non-sensitive) like `hint=check_key_encoding` when detection heuristic (presence of `&` or ` `) hits. will draft a PR.

emily_support: thanks team — closing our side once customer verifies post-rotation.
